results.notes:
Built the server attachment contract. A new model-gateway module, attachment_policy.rs, holds the AttachmentPolicy and its validator.

- Closed codes: attachment_media_unsupported, attachment_too_large, attachment_count_exceeded, attachment_route_unsupported, attachment_encoding_invalid.
- Validation: image mimes png/jpeg/webp/gif, decoded size caps per item and in total, name check (a bare file name; a path or '..' is refused, never repaired), and base64 checked by decoding. A payload far over the cap is refused before it is decoded.
- Route: the route is read from the raw provider and connection id. A subscription turn with any attachment gets attachment_route_unsupported.
- Where it runs: invoke_stream_sse calls validate right after the waiver check, before normalize_stream. normalize_stream would otherwise refuse a subscription turn with attachments under a generic code. A ZDR turn skips validate, so the zdr_features attachments refusal keeps priority. A contract test pins this order in the sse.rs source.
- Switch: CHAT_ATTACHMENT_POLICY_ENABLED is on by default, per the plan row. Only the values "0" and "false" switch it off. When off, validate accepts everything and /v1/models omits attachment_policy.
- Env caps: CHAT_ATTACHMENT_MAX_IMAGES (4), _MAX_IMAGE_BYTES (1,000,000), _MAX_FILES (3), _MAX_FILE_BYTES (1,000,000), _MAX_TOTAL_BYTES (3,145,728). A missing, zero or unparsable value keeps its default.
- Wire changes: InvokeAttachment gained `name`, and `kind:"file"` is recognised.
- /v1/models: now carries a sibling `attachment_policy`. modes.vision is true when any listed model has the "vision" feature.
- Body limit: /v1/invoke/stream on model-gateway and /api/v1/chat/stream on the BFF both take 12 MiB. On model-gateway it can be set with CHAT_STREAM_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES; the BFF value is a const.
- BFF: the route is now streams::stream_route(), so the test drives the same wiring. The BFF test checks a 5 MiB body is not refused and a body over the limit gets 413.
- Frontend: chat-client.ts exports AttachmentPolicy, parseAttachmentPolicy and getAttachmentPolicy. listModels sets the policy as a side effect. A malformed policy is treated as absent. chat-normalizers.ts gives all five codes Norwegian and English text with no retry action.
- Test rows: zdr_feature_table.rs gained two rows (an inline image and a named file under ZDR are both refused as `attachments`).
- A previous attempt had left no partial edits on my files.
